sections.heading: What is IoT and Embedded System Testing?
paragraphs: IoT (Internet of Things) and Embedded System Testing is the process of evaluating the performance, reliability, security, and interoperability of smart devices that combine sensors, actuators, microcontrollers, and communication modules to interact with the environment and the internet. These tests ensure that connected devices function safely and consistently under real-world conditions.

sections.heading: IoT and embedded systems typically include
bullets: Hardware (microcontrollers, sensors, power units)
Firmware (real-time OS, device drivers)
Communication protocols (Wi-Fi, BLE, LoRa, ZigBee, MQTT)
Cloud platforms (AWS IoT, Azure IoT, custom dashboards)
User interfaces (mobile/web apps)

sections.heading: IoT and Embedded System Testing Services by ITC India
paragraphs: At ITC India, our state-of-the-art IoT and embedded testing lab in Mohali offers comprehensive validation across all layers of device design—from edge hardware to cloud integration. Our services include:

sections.heading: 1. ✅ Functional Testing
bullets: Validates all features of the device under normal and extreme conditions.
Includes sensor accuracy, actuator response, and firmware behavior.

sections.heading: 2. ⚡ Electrical and Environmental Testing
bullets: Performed under IEC and ISO guidelines.
Includes EMC/EMI compliance, power surge immunity, temperature cycling, and vibration testing.

sections.heading: 3. 🔐 Security Testing (IEC 62443)
bullets: Checks firmware for vulnerabilities, insecure ports, and unencrypted data.
Evaluates secure boot, key storage, and device authentication.

sections.heading: 4. 🔄 Connectivity and Interoperability Testing
bullets: Validates Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, ZigBee, LoRa, and Cellular communications.
Ensures device can communicate with other devices and cloud platforms.

sections.heading: 5. 🛠️ Firmware and Software Testing
bullets: White-box and black-box testing for embedded firmware.
Uses tools like static analyzers, code profilers, and hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) systems.

sections.heading: 6. 🌐 End-to-End IoT Integration Testing
bullets: From sensor to cloud, ensures seamless data capture, processing, and reporting.
Validates OTA (Over-The-Air) updates, data encryption, and cloud analytics.

sections.heading: 7. 📄 Compliance & Certification Support
bullets: Support for CE, FCC, BIS, ISO/IEC 29119, and other regional/global certifications.
We provide complete documentation, test reports, and conformance matrices.
